posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
It is with much regret I pass on this information from The Holographer.

> It is with great sadness that we have to announce the passing away of one of the most famous names in display holography, Professor Nick Phillips. He died at his home on Saturday 23 May.

I have read many of Nick Phillips papers although I never did meet him. My condolences to his family and friends.

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md:
I am so sad! He was quite a character! He and I plus my sons would always make a trip to my best used bookstores in Chicago during his summer stays at Lake Forest College Summer Workshops.

In memoriam I will send a pdf of an article I wrote for Leonardo entitled "A Toast to Nick Phillips" to anyone who will contact me via this forum.

posts.author: rzeheb
posts.content_md: Ed, I would love to read a copy of your article. Please e-mail to: rzeheb[at]yahoo[dot]com TIA, Ron.

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
There's a basic bio and a link to a medium res (but readable) gif of Ed's Leonardo article here:

[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicholas_J._Phillips](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicholas_J._Phillips)

Also links to a few pics of his holograms.

I will always appreciate his pioneering work on non-toxic rehalogenating bleaches.

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md: Gee, I didn't know about that Wikipedia link to my article! Saves me a lot of work! Enjoy!
